page_title: Info Nutrizionali Vitamin C Effervescent Stick
text:
##### How to use your Vitamin C Stick

Quick guide for optimal use

##### How to use

**In 3 simple steps:**
- Open the stick
- Pour into 200–250 ml of water
- Mix until fully dissolved and drink

##### What it is

Effervescent Vitamin C in a convenient single-dose stick.
Designed for quick preparation and easy daily use, wherever you are.

##### Benefits

- Supports normal immune system function
- Contributes to reduction of tiredness and fatigue
- Provides antioxidant support

##### When to take it

- At any time of the day
- When you need extra Vitamin C
- Perfect on-the-go

##### Important information

Do not exceed the recommended daily dose.
Food supplements should not replace a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle.
Keep out of reach of children.

##### Nutritional information & Ingredients

Component

section: Built for brands at every stage
text: From startups to established companies, we support supplement brands through every phase of growth.

13 Protein Group brings together specialized companies and production capabilities across supplement manufacturing, functional foods and beverages.
Together, they create an integrated network designed to support brands across different product formats, production needs and stages of growth.
Formulation, regulatory compliance and solid-format manufacturing.
Advanced development of powders, shots and liquid supplements.
High-speed bottling and scalable beverage production.
Specialized baking mixes and niche-format solutions.

section: Built over time. Ready for what’s next.
text:
13 Protein was founded in Sweden in 1997 with a clear focus on sports nutrition and functional products.

Over the years, we have expanded our expertise, production capabilities and manufacturing network through continuous investment and strategic acquisitions.

Today, 13 Protein combines decades of industry experience with an integrated manufacturing structure built to support the next generation of supplement brands.

![](2026/07/1997.png)

Foundation & Compliance
13 Protein Import AB is established, building a production-focused company with strong foundations in formulation, regulatory compliance, and solid-format manufacturing.

![](2026/07/2018.png)

Format Expansion
Entry into ready-to-drink production, expanding capabilities into scalable beverage manufacturing for supplement brands.

![](2026/07/2021.png)

Portfolio Diversification
Entry into ready-to-drink production, expanding capabilities into scalable beverage manufacturing for supplement brands.

![](2026/07/2023.png)

Scalable Beverage Infrastructure
Expansion of the Skruv facility, tripling ready-to-drink capacity for cans and PET bottles.

![](2026/07/today.png)

Continuous Growth
Ongoing investments in production capacity, innovation, and regulatory infrastructure - supporting brands in scaling faster and entering new markets.

To become the manufacturing partner of choice for ambitious supplement brands in Europe and beyond.

![](2026/07/vision.png)
To turn product ideas into scalable, market-ready supplements through integrated expertise, reliable manufacturing and long-term partnership.
What drives us
We continuously explore new ingredients, formats, technologies and processes to help brands respond to evolving market needs.

section: We build quality into every step
text: From raw material selection to finished production, quality is integrated throughout our development and manufacturing processes.

Open communication and visibility throughout the process help our customers make better decisions and build stronger products.

We continuously look for ways to improve how we source, produce, package and operate across our manufacturing network.
We work alongside our customers as long-term manufacturing partners, adapting our capabilities as their products, portfolios and markets evolve.

section: At 13 Protein, quality is built into every stage of production.
text:
Our in-house quality control team oversees the production process, from raw material selection to final packaging, supporting consistency, safety and compliance throughout.

Our processes are supported by internationally recognized standards and certifications.
Every batch is tested internally for microbiological quality, heavy metals and nutritional values.
Production follows applicable EU requirements and internationally recognized quality standards.
Suppliers are carefully selected and regularly evaluated according to defined quality requirements.
Every ingredient and production step is tracked and documented.
